property_summary: For any inputs, C.transfer succeeds (returns / does not revert) when calling a callee whose transferFrom performs a state-changing allowance update; replacing call with staticcall prevents the callee from performing that state change and can make the call revert, so the reference always returns true while the mutant can revert for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the low-level call to use staticcall instead of call, making called code unable to modify state and altering observable outcomes when transfer relies on state changes.
